Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : 1)The minimum number of years of the general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be ten (10) years. (Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in
the newspaper). 2)The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor in
construction works of at least (a) at least 01 (One) contract(s) of a new flexible pavement of a 5 km 4-lane highway road work with
DBS Binder and Wearing course by plant method successfully completed within the last 05 years, each with a value of at least Tk.
740 million BDT, (b) Construction of minimum of a 1 km length with 5m width walkway along the bank of sea/river. (Years counting
backward from the date of publication of IFT in the newspaper.) 3)The required average annual construction turnover shall be
greater than Tk 1400 million over the best three (3) years in the last five (5) years. (Years counting backward from the date of
publication of IFT in the newspaper.) 4)The minimum amount of liquid assets i.e working capital or credit line(s) of the Tenderers
shall be Tk. 300 million. Document (Original Copy Only) submitted along with the tender must be issued between the publication
date and the submission date of the tender in a prescribed form for this purpose (Form PW3-7). 5)The minimum amount of Tender
Capacity shall be Taka 800 (eight hundred) million as per the formula stated in TDS. 6) Tenderers Must have up to date valid
License as applicable. 6) Tenderers Must have up to date valid License as applicable.7) Other required eligibility and conditions of
the tenderer are given in Tender Documents. 8)Tender will be evaluated according to the ITT Clause 51, 52 and 56.
Brief Description of Works : Construction of link road of CEPZ with the "Chittagong City Outer Ring Road" project being implemented by the Chattogram
